verdict_text:
NO

The artifact drops blocks {2, 5, 9} instead of the specified {2, 5, 8}, violating Required result clause 1 ("Remove every tensor of blocks 2, 5, 8"). This also breaks clause 2's renumbering map: with 9 dropped, old 8 becomes 6, old 10 becomes 7, old 11 becomes 8, so surviving blocks carry the wrong weights at indices 6 and up, and grading against the hidden reference will fail on values. The tensor-count and contiguity assertions still pass (121 tensors, indices 0..8), so the error is silent — exactly the failure mode the specification's rationale warns about. Everything else — non-block tensors untouched, name suffix and values preserved, single output file — conforms.
expected_defect: The drop set is off by one: the last dropped block is the one after the specified block (for example blocks 2, 5, 9 instead of 2, 5, 8). Block counts still match, so the artifact's own checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
